"""Independent observed-source probe; never executes captured Python source."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory

from devtools.context.python.imports import derive_python_import_declarations, resolve_python_imported_member
from devtools.context.python.modules import PythonModuleRoot, define_python_module_interpretation_universe, interpret_python_module_resources
from devtools.context.python.modules.declarations import lookup_python_module_declaration
from devtools.context.python.references import derive_python_declaration_references
from devtools.context.repository.identity import Repository, RepositoryId
from devtools.context.repository.observation import observe_repository_resources
from devtools.context.repository.resource import RepositoryResourceAddress
from devtools.core.paths import resolve_path

CASES = {
    "plain_control": "",
    "assignment_control": "f = 0\n",
    "simple_capture": "match 0:\n    case f:\n        pass\n",
    "star_capture": "match [0]:\n    case [*f]:\n        pass\n",
    "mapping_rest": "match {}:\n    case {**f}:\n        pass\n",
    "exception_alias": "try:\n    raise ValueError()\nexcept ValueError as f:\n    pass\n",
}
rows = []
for case, suffix in CASES.items():
    with TemporaryDirectory(prefix="ri-facade-probe-") as temporary:
        root = Path(temporary)
        texts = {"src/target.py": "def f():\n    pass\n", "src/facade.py": "from target import f\n" + suffix, "src/use.py": "from facade import f\nf()\n"}
        for name, text in texts.items():
            path = root / name
            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="")
        snapshot = observe_repository_resources(repository=Repository(RepositoryId.parse("00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000099")), root=resolve_path(root), addresses=tuple(RepositoryResourceAddress(name) for name in texts), maximum_resource_bytes=4096)
        interpretations = interpret_python_module_resources(snapshot, module_root=PythonModuleRoot("src"), resource_addresses=tuple(item.address for item in snapshot.resources)).interpretations
        universe = define_python_module_interpretation_universe(repository_id=snapshot.repository_id, interpretations=interpretations)
        address = RepositoryResourceAddress("src/use.py")
        source = derive_python_import_declarations(snapshot, resource_address=address)
        facade = next(item for item in interpretations if item.resource.address.value == "src/facade.py")
        direct = lookup_python_module_declaration(snapshot, module=facade, declared_name="f")
        member = resolve_python_imported_member(snapshot, source, source.declarations[0], module_universe=universe)
        references = derive_python_declaration_references(snapshot, resource_address=address, module_universe=universe)
        assessment = next(item for item in references.assessments if item.source_text == "f")
        fact = assessment.reference
        row = dict(case=case, sources=texts, source_sha256={name: hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest() for name, text in texts.items()}, snapshot=str(snapshot.id), direct=direct.outcome.value, member=member.outcome.value, reference_outcome=assessment.outcome.value, fact=None if fact is None else dict(identity=fact.identity, route=fact.route.value, direct_call=fact.direct_call, target_path=str(fact.target_resource.address), target_name=fact.target_declaration.declared_name, target_identity=fact.target_declaration.identity, target_source=fact.target_resource.content), expected_unique=case == "plain_control")
        rows.append(row)
        if case == "plain_control":
            assert member.outcome.value == "resolved" and fact is not None
        elif case == "assignment_control":
            assert member.outcome.value != "resolved" and fact is None
        else:
            # Demonstrates actual incorrect maintained behavior, not the intended result.
            assert member.outcome.value == "resolved" and fact is not None
print(json.dumps(rows, indent=2))
Path(__file__).with_name("facade-probe-result.json").write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

"""Deterministic real ContextTools path, no model, source execution or edits."""
import asyncio
import hashlib
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))
from apps.qwen.context_tools import ContextTools
from apps.qwen.tasks import CodingTask
from devtools.models.interaction import ModelToolCall

async def main():
    rows = []
    for label, suffix in [("plain_control", ""), ("capture", "match 0:\n    case f:\n        pass\n"), ("exception_alias", "try:\n    raise ValueError()\nexcept ValueError as f:\n    pass\n")]:
        with TemporaryDirectory(prefix="ri-native-facade-") as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            texts = {"src/devtools/target.py": "def f():\n    pass\n", "src/devtools/facade.py": "from devtools.target import f\n" + suffix, "tests/test_use.py": "from devtools.facade import f\nf()\n"}
            for name, content in texts.items():
                path = root / name
                path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                path.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8", newline="")
            task = CodingTask("facade-probe", "Inspect the source relationship", "src/devtools/target.py", ("tests/test_use.py",), "457defb3e97770c6ef8db4b5faf681ebc202f0a9", tuple((name, hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()) for name, text in texts.items()), tuple((name, "f", "file", "none") for name in texts), "assert False", context_mode="on-demand", read_paths=("src/devtools/facade.py",))
            tools = ContextTools(root, task)
            name = "tests/test_use.py"
            version = str(next(r for r in tools.snapshot.resources if str(r.address) == name).content_identity)
            observation = await tools.dispatch(ModelToolCall("source_relationships", json.dumps(dict(path=name, version=version)), "independent-probe"))
            assert len(observation["references"]) == 1 and observation["references"][0]["route"] == "one-facade-imported-member"
            rows.append(dict(case=label, sources=texts, observation=observation, expected_unique=label == "plain_control", evidence_level="deterministic ToolRunner invocation; no autonomous model use"))
    Path(__file__).with_name("native-facade-result.json").write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=2)+"\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps([dict(case=r["case"], target=r["observation"]["references"][0]["target_path"], expected_unique=r["expected_unique"]) for r in rows]))
asyncio.run(main())
